Dave Matthews Band
September 18, 2021
Saratoga Performing Arts Center - Saratoga Springs, NY

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > Zoom F6 (32 Bit Float)
Location: Section 8, Row AA, Seat 6, Front Left of FOH, DFC, Mics DIN ~11'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.36 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing) > Audacity 3.0.4 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)
